name: Blessed Arm
summary: In Stormwind, Blessed Arm carries lightforge iron toward a weapon against Morbent Fel. After salvaging the ingots from the wreck of the Flying Osprey in the Wetlands, you bring the precious metal to master dwarven smith Grimand Elmore, who can shape it to face the necromancer.

sections.title: A Rare Metal Returns
sections.body: Glorin Steelbrow packs the recovered lightforge iron for Stormwind. The metal is rare, and its power against foul and unholy beings demands a smith who knows how to work it. After the shipment came from the wreck of the Flying Osprey off the Wetlands coast, Glorin knew of only one artisan in the southern kingdoms suited to the task: master weaponsmith Grimand Elmore.

sections.title: The Dwarven District's Forge
sections.body: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Grimand Elmore keeps one of the city's finest anvils. Years have passed since he last hammered lightforge iron, he says, when you bring him the recovered shipment. The veteran artisan is intrigued by the chance to strike at the necromancer Morbent Fel, and agrees to put his hammer to work.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this delivery?
aliases: what is crate of lightforge ingots for
faq.answer: The crate holds lightforge iron salvaged from the Flying Osprey wreck in the Wetlands. Glorin Steelbrow sends it to Grimand Elmore, who can shape the consecrated metal into a weapon against the necromancer Morbent Fel.

aliases: who is the smith in dwarven district
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore is a respected dwarven weaponsmith who works in Stormwind's Dwarven District. Few craftsmen have the training to forge specialized metals like lightforge iron.

faq.q: Why is lightforge iron so important against Morbent Fel?
aliases: how does lightforge iron hurt morbent fel
faq.answer: Lightforge iron is renowned for its power against foul and unholy beings. Grimand Elmore can shape the consecrated metal into a weapon to confront the necromancer Morbent Fel.

faq.q: Where does Glorin Steelbrow send you?
aliases: where do i go for blessed arm
faq.answer: Glorin Steelbrow sends you from Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands to Grimand Elmore's forge in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Has Grimand Elmore worked with lightforge iron before?
faq.answer: Yes. Grimand says years have passed since he last worked with lightforge iron, and welcomes the chance to shape the storied metal again.

faq.q: What must happen before the weapon can be finished?
faq.answer: Grimand agrees to forge the recovered lightforge iron into Morbent's Bane. When he is finished, you take the weapon to Sven Yorgen in Duskwood.

angles.text: Lightforge iron is rare and difficult to work. Watching the experienced dwarven smith Grimand Elmore take it on shows the skill needed to forge holy arms.
As a paladin, carrying consecrated iron to shape a weapon against a Duskwood necromancer follows the Silver Hand's calling: meet dark sorcery with holy vigilance.
As an Alliance member, you carry aid between kingdoms, from a dwarven priest in Menethil Harbor to Stormwind's Dwarven District, for the beleaguered people of Duskwood.
